usedFor: Google Forms collects sign-ups, and Zoho Marketing Automation adds each respondent through “Subscribe Lead to Mailing List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in Google Forms, then “Subscribe Lead to Mailing List” in Zoho Marketing Automation
bestTemplate.why: Each response puts the respondent on a mailing list, with tags applied if you set them.

watchOut: “Subscribe Lead to Mailing List” sends a confirmation email, and “New Form Response” is polling, so expect a short delay.
